cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: You Handle the Impossible Part
cards.instruction: Make someone accept responsibility for the one part of the plan that cannot reasonably be done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're returning yesterday's missing hour before lunch. Put it in this jar. I taught you to collect things without spilling them; take your time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Loosen the lid. You always made a small opening and blamed what wouldn't go through it. Try properly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm labeling yesterday. Last time I let you do labels, everything became tomorrow. You're ready for the collecting; leave the dates to me.
